llm.summary: This is a local markdown todo-tracking skill; it creates and renames files in a project todo directory but shows no hidden execution, credential use, network access, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifact purpose is coherent: manage markdown todo files under `todos/`. Metadata includes unrelated `crypto` and `can-make-purchases` capability tags, but the reviewed files do not request or implement those capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to todo naming, templates, status changes, dependency checks, and basic local shell examples such as `ls`, `grep`, `cp`, `mv`, and `awk`.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown instructions, references, and a template only; no executable scripts, installer hooks, package installs, or binary files were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request credentials, API keys, auth/session stores, network endpoints, broad filesystem indexing, or external services.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to user-directed project todo files and status renames inside `todos/`; there is no background worker, startup hook, privilege escalation, or automatic execution.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install if you want an agent to manage local markdown todos. Expect normal use to create, edit, copy, and rename files in a `todos/` directory. The publisher should correct the unrelated crypto and purchase capability tags to avoid confusion.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: The supplied SkillSpector result is clean with no issues. Older metadata hypotheses about tool access and hidden comments were checked against the artifact and did not show unrestricted tool grants or runtime prompt-injection behavior.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan metadata was clean, and local inspection found only non-executable markdown files.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry is pending and provides no negative artifact-backed signal.
